analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI remains sideways in the neutral zone, and the MACD histogram shows improvement but is still in negative territory. Volume is also subdued at 0.57x the 5-day average, lacking the necessary momentum for directional confirmation. Expect continued sideways movement between the 27,045 support and 30,570 resistance levels.
